newsitem.title: CANADA: Northern Telecom gets $300 mln Brazil contract.
newsitem.headline: Northern Telecom gets $300 mln Brazil contract.

text.p: Northern Telecom Ltd., Canada's largest telecommunications equipment maker, said on Thursday it clinched one of its biggest contracts ever with an equipment and services deal in Brazil worth $300 million.

A consortium led by Atlanta-based BellSouth Corp. awarded Nortel the deal. The group, consisting of BellSouth and three Brazilian companies, received a $2.45 billion contract to provide the city of Sao Paulo with a cellular telephone network.

Brampton, Ontario-based Nortel said it would design, build and commission a digital cellular network to serve the Sao Paulo metropolitan area starting in 1998. It added the contract could expand as network capacity increased.

Nortel also said it planned to invest $125 million to make digital wireless telecommunications systems starting in the fourth quarter of 1997 at a Campinas, Sao Paulo State plant in concert with Brazilian engineering firm Promon Eletronica.
Shares in Nortel rose C$2.25 to C$135 on the Toronto Stock Exchange on Thursday and by $1.56 to $98.44 on the New York Stock Exchange.
